# C3 LLaMA Architecture Validation - Full Experiment Suite
# 8 conditions: importance × {0.15,0.20,0.25,0.30} + random × {0.15,0.20,0.25,0.30}
# GPU 2: importance conditions | GPU 3: random conditions
set -e
source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base
cd /root/autodl-tmp/pacs

MODEL=/root/autodl-tmp/models/DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B
DATA=/root/autodl-tmp/pacs/data/math500.json

run_condition() {
    local gpu=$1 method=$2 sparsity=$3
    local sp_str=$(python3 -c "print(f's{int(float(\"$sparsity\")*100):03d}')")
    local outdir="profiling_output_c3_llama_${method}_${sp_str}"
    local logfile="logs/c3_llama_${method}_${sp_str}.log"

    if [ -f "$outdir/profiling_results.json" ]; then
        echo "SKIP: $outdir already exists"
        return 0

    echo "$(date) START: gpu=$gpu method=$method sparsity=$sparsity -> $outdir"
    CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=$gpu python -m pacs.profiling.run_profiling \
        --model_path "$MODEL" \
        --data_path "$DATA" \
        --output_dir "./$outdir" \
        --sparsity_levels "$sparsity" \
        --masking_method "$method" \
        2>&1 | tee "$logfile"
    echo "$(date) DONE: $outdir"
}

mkdir -p logs

# GPU 2: importance conditions (sequential)
(
    for sp in 0.15 0.20 0.25 0.30; do
        run_condition 2 importance $sp

) &

(
    for sp in 0.15 0.20 0.25 0.30; do

    done
    echo "$(date) ALL RANDOM DONE"
) &
PID_RAND=$!

echo "Importance PID=$PID_IMP (GPU 2), Random PID=$PID_RAND (GPU 3)"
wait $PID_IMP $PID_RAND
echo "$(date) ALL C3 LLAMA EXPERIMENTS COMPLETE"
